theme.title: Stars and Surprises
theme.subtitle: Teams, stars and stories from across basketball
theme.recap: The best numbers come from all over basketball history. Which answer surprised you most?

questions.prompt: How many regular-season games did the 1974–75 Bullets win before the Finals?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Washington Bullets (60–22) for the championship

funFacts.text: The Washington Bullets had only recently relocated from Baltimore, where the franchise previously played.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: having moved from Baltimore prior to the 1973–74 season

funFacts.text: Wes Unseld and Elvin Hayes anchored a team coached by future Celtics icon K. C. Jones.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: led by Wes Unseld and Elvin Hayes, and coached by K. C. Jones

funFacts.text: Washington knocked out the defending champion Celtics on the way to the championship series.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: then overcame the Buffalo Braves and the defending champion Boston Celtics

questions.prompt: How many consecutive games did Milwaukee win to open 2018–19?
questions.context: Milwaukee Bucks · start of Giannis's first MVP season
questions.note: Seven in a row before their first defeat.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The Bucks opened the season with seven straight wins

funFacts.text: The Bucks' season-opening victory was a one-point road win over Charlotte.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: October 17 @ Charlotte W 113–112

funFacts.text: Milwaukee's first loss came on the road against Boston in early November.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: November 1 @ Boston L 113–117

funFacts.text: That opening run marked the club's fastest start since its early-1970s title-contending era.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the first time they started a season 7–0 since 1971–72

questions.prompt: Stephen Curry’s streak of regular-season games with a made three ended in November 2016. How many games did it last?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Most consecutive regular-season games with a made three-pointer: 157

funFacts.text: The streak stopped in Los Angeles when Curry couldn't make an outside shot against the Lakers.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: against the Los Angeles Lakers, with Curry going 0 for 10 from three-point range

funFacts.text: Kyle Korver had held the previous regular-season made-three streak record.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: previous record of 127 held by Kyle Korver

funFacts.text: Across regular-season and playoff games combined, Curry had also set a separate longer made-three streak.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Most consecutive games (regular-season and postseason combined) with a made three-pointer

questions.prompt: How many points did LeBron score in Game 1 of the 2009 Eastern finals?
questions.context: Cleveland vs Orlando · Eastern Conference finals · Game 1
questions.note: 49 points, but Orlando won the opener by one.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: May 20 Orlando L 106–107 LeBron James (49)

funFacts.text: Cleveland swept both Detroit and Atlanta before the Eastern Conference finals.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the Cavaliers swept the Detroit Pistons in the First Round in four games, swept the Atlanta Hawks in the Semifinals in four games

funFacts.text: LeBron averaged a remarkable 35.3 points during Cleveland's entire playoff run.
The Magic eventually reached the NBA Finals but lost to Kobe Bryant's Lakers.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The Magic would go on to lose to the Los Angeles Lakers in the NBA Finals in five games.
